effect: +389 closures just under the 240-min SLA (4.7x expected)
reason: 389 more critical cases were closed in the 30 minutes before the 240-minute SLA than the smooth counterfactual predicts (4.7x), with ~42 missing just after it - the signature of closures timed to the metric.
name: SLA-threshold bunching (metric gaming)
method: Bunching estimator: excess mass of critical closures just below the SLA vs a polynomial counterfactual (Chetty et al. 2011; Kleven 2016)
